observation.command:
cd /workspace
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "objections -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/objections-management
sleep 45
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "codec -> %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:8080/process/start/temporal-codec
sleep 60
echo "=== endpoint check ==="
for p in 18000 18001 18002 18003 18005 18006 18007 18008 18009 18010 18011 18012 18013 18014 18015 18016 18020 18021 18022 18024 3002; do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 2 http://localhost:$p/docs 2>/dev/null); [ "$code" != "200" ] && echo "port $p: $code"; done; echo "check done (only non-200 listed)"
free -h | awk 'NR==2{print "mem:", $3" used", $7" avail"}'
